property.name: subtitle
property.value: Every mechanism together beneath the last moon

property.name: text
property.value: The final constellation combines every lesson. Read the signs, watch the rhythm, and keep a recovery route in sight.

property.name: text
property.value: First lock: cross the carpet in the wind, then slash the guard before the gate.

property.name: text
property.value: Second lock: ride the wheel, jump to the pendulum, and land before the ghul.

property.name: text
property.value: Third lock: toggle the moon stair, run over crumbles, and use the drum for the last balcony.

property.name: text
property.value: Final lock: the water wheel turns against the wind. Wait for the gap, then sprint through the starlit court.
